Lemma
Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0080 1. Lemma 3.1\group variation-formulas

If $\partial _t g_{ij}=h_{ij}$, then the inverse metric satisfies \[ \partial _t g^{ij}=-g^{ik}g^{j\ell }h_{k\ell }. \]

Proof

Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0080, chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0081 \sketch Differentiating $\delta ^i_{\ell }=g^{ik}g_{k\ell }$ gives

\[ 0=(\partial _t g^{ik})g_{k\ell }+g^{ik}h_{k\ell }, \]

and multiplying by $g^{j\ell }$ yields the stated formula.

□
